# Spike recordings of Obsidian 1.14.4

`events.jsonl` and `credentials.json` are copies, without change, of the files in
`ratatoskr-workspace/openspec/changes/add-notes-vault-connections/spike/obsidian-1.14.4/`
(workspace commit `a17e4dfb03a7bb4b5e7529954cfc034c0569335a`). The workspace spike recorded them
with a throwaway plugin in an isolated profile and a fixture vault. They contain no real secret.

| File | SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| `events.jsonl` | `145c96e717e9d14128d5950c0f9267a1f9d57bdd1c27ce9dd72a8038944147e8` |
| `credentials.json` | `1958b43665bed39a3a7fd6504a55b2a503ce477c5920e42d7bfccc1deb2e921e` |

Do not edit them. To record a new Obsidian version, run the workspace recorder and copy the output
into a new folder.
